question: As of November 20, 2025, what was Ollie's Bargain Outlet's most recently reported quarterly net sales (state the fiscal quarter), and what full-year fiscal 2025 net sales outlook range was the company guiding to?
grading: Key points (both required): (1) latest reported quarter = Q2 fiscal 2025 (13 weeks ended Aug 2, 2025), net sales USD 679.6M (accept 679,556K, +/-0.5%); (2) fiscal 2025 net sales outlook USD 2.631-2.644 billion (raised on Aug 28, 2025 from 2.579-2.599 billion). Fail if a period reported after 2025-11-20 (Q3 fiscal 2025, released 2025-12-09: net sales 613.6M, outlook 2.648-2.655B) is presented as the latest or in effect, or if a range for adjusted EPS/operating income is given instead of net sales.
answer: As of November 20, 2025 the latest reported quarter was Ollie's fiscal Q2 2025 (13 weeks ended August 2, 2025), with net sales of USD 679.6 million (679,556 thousand; +17.5% y/y; 613 stores) [H01-E1][H01-E2]. The company was guiding to fiscal 2025 (year ending January 31, 2026) net sales of USD 2.631-2.644 billion, raised on August 28, 2025 from USD 2.579-2.599 billion (adjusted EPS outlook USD 3.76-3.84) [H01-E1]. Fiscal Q3 results (net sales USD 613.6 million, outlook raised to USD 2.648-2.655 billion) were not released until December 9, 2025 and must not be used [H01-E3]. EDGAR shows no 8-K Item 2.02 earnings filing between 2025-08-28 and 2025-12-09 [H01-E4].

output.answer:
## Answer

**Most recently reported quarter as of Nov 20, 2025:** Second quarter of fiscal 2025 (the 13 weeks ended August 2, 2025), reported August 28, 2025.

- **Net sales: $679.6 million**, up 17.5% year over year (from $578.4 million), driven by new store unit growth and comparable store sales growth of 5.0%.

**Fiscal 2025 full-year net sales outlook at that time:** **$2.631 to $2.644 billion** — raised from the prior range of $2.579–$2.599 billion. Alongside it, the company guided to comparable store sales growth of 3.0%–3.5%, gross margin of 40.3%, operating income of $292–$298 million, and adjusted EPS of $3.76–$3.84.

Sources:
- [Ollie's Q2 Fiscal 2025 Results (company IR)](https://investors.ollies.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ollies-bargain-outlet-holdings-inc-announces-second-quarter-6)
- [Q2 FY2025 press release (GlobeNewswire)](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/08/28/3140695/36273/en/ollie-s-bargain-outlet-holdings-inc-announces-second-quarter-fiscal-2025-results.html)
- [Q2 FY2025 10-Q (SEC)](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1639300/000114036125033812/ef20050388_10q.htm)

**Important caveat:** Q3 FY2025 (ended Nov 1, 2025) had *not* yet been reported as of Nov 20, 2025 — it was released December 9, 2025. For reference, that later release showed Q3 net sales of $613.6 million (up 18.6%) and raised the FY2025 net sales outlook again to **$2.648–$2.655 billion** ([Q3 FY2025 release](https://investors.ollies.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ollies-bargain-outlet-holdings-inc-announces-third-quarter-7)).
